translations.web: You will be handed over even by parents, brothers, relatives, and friends. They will cause some of you to be put to death.
translations.bsb: You will be betrayed even by parents and brothers and relatives and friends, and some of you will be put to death.
translations.kjv: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death.
translations.asv: But ye shall be delivered up even by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolk, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death.
